# An existing cold-chain delivery service already works: refrigerated last-mile delivery for temperature-sensitive goods

An existing cold-chain delivery service already works: refrigerated last-mile delivery for temperature-sensitive goods. This room reviews it from four angles to ask how the same underlying capability could extend to adjacent uses, grounded in the idea that intersections between fields are where the next opportunity usually hides.
